title.value: Repository-Level Prompt Generation for Large Language Models of Code
title.justification: The paper introduces a framework, Repo-Level Prompt Generator, focusing on generating prompts for code autocompletion in large language models.
title.quote: We propose a framework called Repo-Level Prompt Generator that learns to generate example-specific prompts using prompt proposals.

extractions.description: This paper presents the Repo-Level Prompt Generator (RLPG), designed to improve the effectiveness of large language models (LLMs) for code by generating repository-specific prompts. The RLPG framework considers the structure and context from the entire code repository to tailor prompts that enhance single-line code-autocompletion tasks. The approach does not require access to the LLM's weights, making it applicable even with black-box access. The paper demonstrates significant improvements over baseline systems like Codex when generating prompts tailored to the specifics of code repositories.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The main focus of the paper is the enhancement of code autocompletion capabilities in large language models through improved prompt generation methodologies, with no emphasis on Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Despite the growing popularity of LLMs of code, there is no work that systematically tackles different aspects of prompt generation in relation to source code.

primary_category.justification: The paper does not address any specific Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development themes or applications, focusing instead on technical improvements in code-related LLM usage.
primary_category.quote: We focus on the task of single-line code-autocompletion in an IDE, where the objective is to predict the blanked-out portion (or target hole) starting from the position of an imagined cursor to the end of line.

primary_sub_category.justification: No sub-category related to Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development is addressed.
primary_sub_category.quote: On the task of single-line code-autocompletion, we show that an oracle constructed from our proposed prompt proposals gives up to 36% relative improvement over Codex.

new_primary_category.justification: Given the current content and focus of the paper, it does not relate to Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development and thus doesn't require a new category.
new_primary_category.quote: We demonstrate that an oracle constructed from our prompt proposals gives a remarkably high relative improvement of 36% over Codex, showing the quality of these proposals.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: No new sub-category is needed as the paper’s content is not relevant to any Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development areas.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: Our key contributions are as follows: • We propose a framework called the Repo-Level Prompt Generator (RLPG) that learns to generate prompts conditioned on the example, without requiring access to the weights of the LLM.
